title: 2026-11-07 · Why the Director ran everything at full strength, and stopped being a steward
description: Diagnosis of one Project Director session: 9 of 12 workers inherited the strongest tier at extra-high, and a literal rollout request bypassed each project's own Director. Revised by two independent reviews (primary cause: no steward stance; amplifier: compaction without re-load; the partial read is a symptom). The owner then retracted one proposed fix in favour of a roster and sub-directors, an open design. Report, slides and diagrams inside.
